target.statement: Cohesion Ratio (rho) for HAC (k-est) averaged over dataset-model pairs, reported as 1.2786 in Table 3
target.dataset: BLESS (200 instances, 17 classes) — smallest dataset; single dataset-model cell of the Cohesion Ratio

compute.basis: BLESS is tiny (200 texts) and the spectral estimator caps subsamples at tau=1000, so eigendecompositions are cheap on CPU; the main cost is downloading/loading one embedding model (e5-large-instruct ~560M params) and running HAC + Cohesion Ratio, but the paper's exact pipeline (62 variants, 4 models) and any missing configs mean rebuilding the protocol, and the 8B models would be infeasible on 16GB RAM.
